title: Stand By for Crime
identity_notes: Syndicated crime series built around Los Angeles radio newsman Chuck Morgan and secretary Carol Curtis. The frozen GRH set is the 26-program U.S. production from 1953. Contemporary and Australian/reference sources document a later expansion to 52 total programs, with the second 26 produced in Australia; those absent programs are represented only as series history, not manufactured as archive episodes.

historical_context.title: 1953 U.S. syndicated crime production
historical_context.description: The frozen 26-program set is the U.S.-produced half of Stand By for Crime, distributed as a transcription package.

historical_context.title: Radio newscaster as amateur detective
historical_context.description: Glenn Langan’s Chuck Morgan is a Los Angeles radio newsman whose reporting leads him into criminal investigations.

historical_context.title: Australian-produced second half
